one_liner.zh: 大涨周过后BTC几乎走平（-0.1%），标签落在偏震荡×杠杆中性×中等波动，IV相对RV仍溢价；加密与传统呈偏独立，美现货BTC ETF通道维持温和流入（+9.24亿美金）。
one_liner.en: After the prior surge week, BTC finished nearly flat (−0.1%), labeled chop × leverage-neutral × mid vol with IV still rich to RV; crypto looked idiosyncratic vs TradFi, while US spot BTC ETFs stayed in mild inflow (+924.48M).

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 +9.24 亿美金

risk.zh: 中等 RV 与偏贵 IV 仍在；清算峰值落在周一（笔数）/周二（qty）后未放大，且未与 OI 周高同日——若后续出现清算∥OI 同日尖峰，中性叙事才会被改写。
risk.en: Mid RV with rich IV remains; liq peak Mon (count)/Tue (qty) did not cascade and was not same-day with OI week high — only a later liq∥OI same-day spike would rewrite the neutral read.

watch.zh: 盯温和 ETF 流入与 IV−RV 能否收窄；杠杆侧另核：是否出现清算峰值与 OI 日高同日的出清事件（本周没有）。偏独立格局是否被传统风险偏好重新拴住。
watch.en: Watch mild ETF inflow and IV−RV compression; on leverage, whether a same-day liq peak ∥ OI daily-high flush event appears (absent this week). Whether idiosyncratic tape retethers to TradFi risk appetite.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC窗口收益约-0.1%，ETH约-1.9%，两者都远弱于前一周的大幅上冲；相对美股ES/NQ小幅收红与VIX回落，加密更像在消化自身仓位与波动溢价，而非同步风险-on。
compare.en: BTC’s window return was about −0.1% and ETH about −1.9%, a sharp cool-down from the prior surge; versus mild ES/NQ greens and a softer VIX, crypto read more like digestion of its own positioning and vol premium than a shared risk-on tape.

path.zh: 路径标签偏震荡：周一附近清算笔数峰值、次日 qty 仍高，但 OI 周高错开在 08-27，全周未再走出单边趋势；收盘几乎贴着基线，像是大涨后的横盘消化，而非清算驱动去杠杆或反转确认。
path.en: Path labeled chop: liq count peaked near Monday with qty still high next day, but OI week high was staggered on 08-27; no one-way trend after — close hugged baseline, post-surge digestion rather than liq-driven deleveraging or reversal confirmation.

leverage.zh:
标签：杠杆中性。
① 拥挤线：funding 年化约 +11.0%/yr → +8.0%/yr，租金回落仍处中高；OI 周变约 +0.75%（105550 → 106341），库存微增——有持仓、未见疯加。
② 出清线：周内有清算抬升——笔数峰在 08-24（n≈1761），qty 峰在 08-25（约 2.0× 中位量级）；OI 周高在 08-27（约 108782），与清算峰值日不同日。峰值日前后 OI 未走出持续坍塌，也未与清算同日双高。读作：有流量式清算，但不是清算驱动的去杠杆周。
③ 量旁证：永续约 894 亿美金，WoW 约 −20%，活跃度中性——热闹度下降。
收句：拥挤线降温仍中高、出清线「有峰无双高/无 OI 倒掉」→ 程序标中性成立；解释的是为何不是清算驱动，而非否认周内曾有清算抬升。不归因涨跌。
leverage.en:
Label: leverage neutral.
① Crowding: funding ~+11.0%/yr → ~+8.0%/yr (still mid-high); OI +0.75% week (105550 → 106341) — inventory ticked up, not a mania add.
② Flush: liq lifted — count peak 08-24 (n≈1761), qty peak 08-25 (~2.0× median); OI week high 08-27 (~108782), not same day as liq peaks. No sustained OI collapse around peaks, no same-day dual-high. Read: flow-like liquidations, not a liquidation-driven deleveraging week.
③ Volume: perp ~89.4B USD, WoW ~−20%, activity normal — cooler tape.
Close: cooling-but-still-mid-high crowding + flush “peak without dual-high / without OI wipe” supports neutral; explains why not liquidation-driven, without denying liq lifted. No price causation.

etf.zh: 美现货BTC ETF合计净申赎约+9.24亿美金（温和流入，4入1出，单日最大流入约3.38亿在8/24，8/28出现约2.02亿流出）；ETH ETF约+8.24亿、五日全入。并陈Binance侧BTC现货成交额周合计约96.1亿美金、环比约-21%，现货通道有净流入但交易所现货热闹度同步降温，不宜把净流直接焊成涨跌原因。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETFs netted about +$924.48M (mild inflow; 4 in / 1 out; max day ~$338M on 8/24, ~$202M outflow on 8/28); ETH ETFs ~+$824.42M across five inflow days. Alongside, Binance-side BTC spot turnover summed ~$9.61B, WoW about −21%—spot channel saw net creations while exchange spot activity cooled; do not weld flows to the week’s flat price.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 96.05 亿美金，相对上完整周 -21.3%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 122.04 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-08-24（23.68 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 893.99 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 9.61B, vs prior full week -21.3% (activity “normal”; prior ~12.20B). Peak day 2026-08-24 (2.37B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (89.40B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: IV高于RV表示期权市场对未来波动的报价仍贵于刚走过的实现路径；在价格几乎走平的一周，这种溢价更像“保险不便宜”，而不是趋势加速的燃料。
vol_teach.en: IV above RV means options still price future moves richer than the path just realized; with price nearly flat, that premium reads more like “insurance isn’t cheap” than fuel for a fresh trend leg.

vol_week.zh: BTC实现波动年化约30.9%（中等），期末Deribit IV约37.0%，IV−RV点差约+6.1个百分点，标签为期权偏贵。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~30.9% ann. (mid); end Deribit IV ~37.0%, IV−RV spread ~+6.1 pts—labeled IV rich vs RV.

vol_combo.zh: 中等RV + IV溢价 + 价格横盘，组合上更贴近波动收割/均值回归语境，而非单边趋势 fol lowing；若溢价持续而价格不破区间，卖方舒适区与买方追涨杀跌都会受挤压。
vol_combo.en: Mid RV + rich IV + flat price sits closer to vol-harvest / mean-reversion framing than trend-following; persistent premium inside a range squeezes both premium sellers’ comfort and momentum chasers.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周线几乎零收益，IV却仍高于RV约6个点，说明波动报价并未因“无事发生”而立刻坍塌，市场仍在为尾部或事件预留费用。
vol_price_iv.en: Near-zero weekly price return while IV stayed ~6 pts over RV shows vol pricing did not collapse just because “nothing happened”—the tape still charged for tails or event risk.

vol_vix.zh: VIX窗口约-4.6%，美股波动温和回落；BTC的IV−RV溢价与加密偏独立标签并置，传统恐慌降温并未同步抹平加密期权溢价。
vol_vix.en: VIX window ~−4.6% as equity vol eased; set beside BTC’s IV−RV premium and the idiosyncratic label, softer TradFi fear did not automatically erase crypto option richness.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 传统括号内ES约+0.4%、NQ约+0.35%，VIX回落，美元指数约+0.9%，美债10Y约-1.8bp，黄金约-3.2%；加密价格近乎走平且标签为偏独立，联动弱于“同涨同跌”周。
tradfi_summary.en: In the TradFi bracket ES ~+0.4%, NQ ~+0.35%, VIX down, DXY ~+0.9%, US10Y ~−1.8 bp, gold ~−3.2%; crypto’s near-flat print and idiosyncratic label showed weaker lockstep than a classic risk-on/off week.

three_conclusions.zh: 大涨之后的本周是“平价格、温流入、冷成交”：BTC近乎零收益，ETF温和流入与现货/永续成交额双双环比约-20%并陈，通道有钱进但热闹度下降。
three_conclusions.en: Post-surge week read “flat price, mild inflow, cooler turnover”: BTC near zero, mild ETF inflow set beside spot and perp turnover both ~−20% WoW—capital entered the channel while activity cooled.

three_conclusions.zh: 波动结构是中等RV叠加IV溢价约6点，期权仍偏贵；在偏震荡与杠杆中性下，这更像定价粘性，而不是杠杆推动的波动扩张。
three_conclusions.en: Vol structure was mid RV with ~6 pt IV richness—options still expensive; under chop and neutral leverage this looks like sticky pricing, not leverage-driven vol expansion.

three_conclusions.zh: 传统小涨、VIX回落，加密标签偏独立且自身走平，跨资产共振弱；记一笔即可，无需当成趋势反转周。
three_conclusions.en: TradFi mildly green with VIX down while crypto stayed idiosyncratic and flat—weak cross-asset lockstep; file as S1, not a trend-reversal week.

text.zh: BTC现货ETF净流能否连续第二周维持流入（或由温和流入转为流出/大幅放量）。
text.en: Whether BTC spot ETF net flow stays positive a second week (or flips from mild inflow to outflow / a much larger print).

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周已是流入斜率放缓的温和流入，且价格近乎走平；下期核对通道姿态是否续写，是观察现货需求韧性的直接哨。

text.zh: IV−RV点差（本周末约+6.1）是否收窄到中性附近，或在价格仍横盘时维持偏贵。
text.en: Whether the IV−RV spread (~+6.1 at week-end) compresses toward neutral or stays rich while price remains range-bound.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 期权偏贵是本周核心矛盾之一；溢价去留直接关系到波动收割叙事是否还站得住。

text.zh: 加密相对ES/NQ的“偏独立”是否延续：若传统续涨/VIX续落，BTC是否仍接近零相关走平或脱钩结束。
text.en: Whether crypto’s idiosyncratic stance vs ES/NQ persists: if TradFi stays bid and VIX soft, does BTC remain near-uncorrelated flat or does the decouple end.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周传统小涨而BTC走平，标签已是偏独立；下期可验证脱钩是短暂消化还是结构切换。

matched.zh: 匹配均值回归与波动收割：偏震荡路径、杠杆中性、中等RV叠加IV溢价，价格未给出干净趋势斜率，更适合区间与卖贵波动的叙事框架（解释匹配，非推荐）。
matched.en: Matched mean-reversion and vol-harvest: chop path, neutral leverage, mid RV with rich IV, and no clean trend slope fit range and “sell rich vol” framing (explains the match, not a recommendation).

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟随不匹配：窗口收益近零、标签偏震荡，缺乏可持续的方向动量，追线容易在横盘里反复止损。
mismatched.en: Trend-following mismatched: near-zero window return and chop label offered little durable directional momentum—line-chasing gets whipsawed in the range.
